digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate and completion-verifier attestation contract
propositions: Operator-attested evidence lacks deterministic enforcement of measurement provenance (environment, principal, privilege_posture, instrument) in the record, allowing claims grounded in the wrong AWS account or under broader privileges than production to pass gates undetected

Privilege-masking escapes occur when evidence is collected under a wildcard identity or through policy simulation rather than live calls, making success structurally unable to fail for the reason that matters, yet current attestation cannot distinguish these instrument types

Plans asserting unchanged behavior across configuration swaps (provider, route, model, endpoint) cite only configuration keys in their Scope while omitting the files that resolve and consume those configurations, rendering their assertions invisible to gate review

Ground truth reachable from the repository is still missed when it lives multiple hops across uncited files, because reviewers read only what plans point to and narrow Scope appears as commendable discipline rather than a defect in citation
